In this Ember version array mutation calls arrayContentWillChange, which materializes the @each proxy when it is watched, and EachProxy#arrayDidChange fires propertyDidChange(content, '@each') — so pushObject does invalidate a CP that depends on 'rejectedEmails.@each'. Ember itself uses bare '.@each' dependent keys (e.g. 'sortProperties.@each').
